title: ISEH, Why HCA 2026 - Selects (Gaps Closed)
facility: HCA UK at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health

shots.description: Low-angle view of a dark wall sign at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health with a quote in white and red lettering describing the ISEH as an international centre of excellence for sport and exercise medicine. Ceiling lights reflect on the sign's glossy surface as the camera drifts slightly.
shots.text_on_screen: "THE ISEH IS AN INTERNATIONAL CENTRE OF EXCELLENCE FOR THE PROVISION OF WORLD-CLASS SPORT AND EXERCISE MEDICINE"

shots.description: A staff member in an ISEH polo shirt stands and talks with a seated man next to a flexible breathing hose, likely before an exercise or breathing test. The man looks up and responds while the staff member listens.

A staff member in an ISEH polo shirt stands beside a seated young man, explaining something to him with hand gestures during an appointment at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health. The shot is filmed from a low angle.

Low-angle shot of an ISEH staff member in a black branded polo explaining and gesturing to a young male patient in a testing room, with a flexible white hose in the foreground. The staff member appears to be talking him through a sports or exercise assessment.

A staff member in a black ISEH polo shirt explains something with hand gestures to a seated man, who looks up and listens. A large flexible white hose, likely part of exercise or breathing test equipment, runs through the foreground.

A staff member in an ISEH polo shirt stands and explains a test to a seated man beside a white testing unit with a flexible breathing hose at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health. The two talk face to face in a bright clinical testing room.

A male staff member in a black ISEH polo shirt with a name badge looks down and talks while working, likely explaining something to a person out of frame, in a bright room with a window blind behind him.

A clinician in a black ISEH polo shirt with a name badge works with a young male patient in a treatment room, handling a roll of white tape or bandage. The camera moves up from his hands to his face as he talks to the patient.
shots.text_on_screen: ISEH Institute of Sport, Exercise & Health

shots.description: A young man in a black t-shirt holds a blue nasal probe to one nostril while closing the other with his finger, carrying out a nasal breathing test. A staff member in a black polo stands behind him.

A man wearing a nose clip breathes through a mouthpiece connected to breathing tubing during a lung function or exercise breathing test at ISEH, while a staff member in an ISEH polo shirt stands beside him and explains the test.

A staff member in an ISEH polo shirt explains a breathing test to a seated man, who holds a hose connected to a respiratory testing machine in an exercise testing room with an exercise bike behind them.
kit: respiratory testing machine with breathing hose

shots.description: A man seated in a testing room breathes through a mouthpiece connected by a hose to a lung function testing machine while a staff member in an ISEH polo shirt stands beside him, watching and coaching him through the test. An exercise bike is visible in the background.

A clinician in an ISEH-branded polo shirt looks down and speaks while working with a patient, seen only as the top of a head at the bottom of the frame, in a clinic room at HCA UK at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health. A window and a wall-mounted noticeboard are behind him.
shots.text_on_screen: ISEH Institute of Sport Exercise & Health

shots.description: A man wearing a nose clip breathes through a mouthpiece connected to a breathing tube during a lung function or exercise breath test, while a staff member stands behind him. An exercise bike is visible in the background.

A clinician taps the touchscreen on a lung function testing machine while a patient, seen from behind, breathes through a mouthpiece attached to a white corrugated tube. A respiratory or cardiopulmonary assessment at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health.

A shirtless male patient has his shoulder examined by a clinician in purple gloves, who places a small round pad or sensor on the back of his shoulder. The clinician steps into view behind him at the end of the shot in a clinic room with a monitor in the background.

A clinician in an ISEH t-shirt and purple gloves examines the collarbone and upper chest area of a shirtless male patient in a clinic room. The patient looks to the side while the clinician presses along his collarbone.

A clinician in an ISEH polo shirt and blue gloves untangles ECG lead wires and a strap as he prepares equipment, likely for a test with a person standing partly out of frame at the right.

A shirtless young man with ECG electrodes and leads on his chest lifts his arm while a staff member in a black polo prepares him for a cardiac or exercise test at HCA UK at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health. An ECG monitor screen is visible in the background.

A staff member in purple gloves prepares a face mask for a cardiopulmonary exercise test while a shirtless male patient with ECG electrodes on his chest stands and watches.

A staff member in blue gloves holds a face mask for a cardiopulmonary exercise test and talks to a shirtless patient with ECG electrodes attached to his chest. A screen behind them shows the CardioSoft cardiac testing system.

A clinician in an ISEH polo and purple gloves holds a blue breathing mask and talks a shirtless man with ECG electrodes on his chest through the test. The scene appears to be the setup for a cardiopulmonary exercise test.

A shirtless young man with ECG electrodes on his chest holds a blue gas analysis face mask in place while a staff member in purple gloves fits the head straps, preparing him for a cardiopulmonary exercise test at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health.

A staff member fits a blue breathing mask to a young man sitting on an exercise bike with ECG electrodes on his chest, preparing him for a cardiopulmonary exercise test in a sports medicine lab.

A man wearing a breathing mask and ECG electrodes on his chest undergoes a cardiopulmonary exercise test while a staff member in purple gloves watches the live results on a monitor. The test is taking place at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health.

A man wearing a gas analysis mask and ECG electrodes on his bare chest does a cardiopulmonary exercise test while a staff member in a black polo shirt watches live graphs on a monitor. The camera moves past the patient to show the screen and the staff member.

A staff member in gloves adjusts ECG leads on a shirtless man wearing a gas analysis face mask while he pedals an exercise bike during a cardiopulmonary exercise test at the Institute of Sport, Exercise and Health.

Close-up of a man wearing a blue face mask with a breathing sensor and ECG electrodes on his chest during a cardiopulmonary exercise (VO2 max) test, likely on an exercise bike. Another person is blurred in the background.

A shirtless patient wearing a face mask connected to a gas analyser and ECG electrodes on his chest grips the handlebars during a cardiopulmonary exercise test (CPET). The camera moves from the mask and chest down the arm to his hands.

A patient wearing ECG electrodes on the chest grips the handlebars of an exercise bike while a clinician in purple gloves adjusts the setup during an exercise test. The face is not shown and the clinician is seen only by their hands.

Close-up profile of a man with curly dark hair and a moustache, looking off to the right as he listens, with a bright window softly out of focus behind him.

Close-up portrait of a man with curly dark hair and a moustache, wearing a black and white top. He starts in profile with his eyes closed, then turns his head towards camera and looks thoughtfully off to the side in front of a bright, softly blurred window; his role is not evident.
Close-up of a staff member's purple-gloved hand using a computer mouse on a tray attached to a workstation, with an out-of-focus monitor showing a coloured image in the background.
